_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF Data Description profile UML. Sources: metadataBuildingBlocks/_sources/profiles/cdifProfiles/CDIFDataDescriptionProfile/CDIFDataDescriptionProfileSchema.json and ../../cdifProperties/cdifDataDescription/cdifDataDescriptionSchema.json. Data Description composes Core + cdifDataDescription. On top of Discovery's variableMeasured, this profile adds variable-level physicalDataType, distribution-level file characterization (characterSet, fileSize), plus the cdif:hasPrimaryKey and cdif:statistics extension points. This config defines the additions only; the full UML is assembled by composing CDIFCore + CDIFDiscovery + this profile. Conforms-to: https://w3id.org/cdif/data_description/1.0.

transformation.description: DDI-CDI to CDIF Data Description Profile

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF Data Description Profile
targetModel.subTitle: Data-description additions over CDIF Discovery: variable physicalDataType, file characterization, primary key, statistics
targetModel.definition: CDIF Data Description profile - extends Discovery with detailed variable descriptions (physicalDataType), distribution file characterization (character set, file size), primary key declarations, and statistical summaries.
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Data Description profile additions on top of Core + Discovery.

package.name: Variables
package.definition: Variable description classes (InstanceVariable subset used in Data Description).

package.name: Support
package.definition: Supporting structured types: Identifier, DefinedTerm, Reference (stubs; full definitions in CDIFCore).

class._comment: InstanceVariable as referenced by schema:variableMeasured at the Data Description level. Adds physicalDataType, describedUnitOfMeasure, unitOfMeasureKind, role. Mapped from DDI-CDI InstanceVariable directly.

attribute._comment: Flatten DDI-CDI ControlledVocabularyEntry source type to a skos:Concept reference (CDIF profile policy).
attribute.name: describedUnitOfMeasure

attribute._comment: Flatten DDI-CDI ControlledVocabularyEntry source type to a skos:Concept reference (CDIF profile policy).
attribute.name: unitOfMeasureKind

class._comment: VariableMeasured wrapper that the Data Description profile uses as the value of schema:variableMeasured. Holds the cdif:physicalDataType required at this profile level.
class.definition: schema:variableMeasured payload at the Data Description level. Wraps a DDI-CDI InstanceVariable reference with additional CDIF-required properties: cdif:physicalDataType and (optionally) cdif:role.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - URI for this variable description.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - short variable name.

attribute.name: description
attribute.definition: schema:description - human-readable description.

attribute.name: propertyId
attribute.definition: schema:propertyID - URI of the property concept.

attribute.name: unitText
attribute.definition: schema:unitText - unit of measure as text.

attribute.name: unitCode
attribute.definition: schema:unitCode - URI for the unit.

attribute._comment: Per CDIF profile policy: DDI-CDI's cdi:physicalDataType (originally a ControlledVocabularyEntry / PairedControlledVocabularyEntry structured DataType) is implemented as a skos:Concept reference. The Concept stub lives in this profile so the type is locally resolvable; the canonical SKOS Concept definition lives in the CDIFCodelist profile (cross-profile linked in the HTML).
attribute.name: physicalDataType
attribute.definition: cdif:physicalDataType / cdi:physicalDataType - XSD-style data type for the physical representation, expressed as a reference to a skos:Concept in a controlled vocabulary (e.g. XSD-types scheme). Required at the Data Description level.

attribute.name: role
attribute.definition: cdif:role - role of this variable in the data set (Identifier / Measure / Attribute / Dimension). At the Data Structure level this lives on the component class instead.

class._comment: PhysicalDataSet-based file characterization. Mapped from DDI-CDI PhysicalDataSet with file-level attributes.
class.definition: schema:DataDownload extended for the Data Description profile - adds character-set and file-size attributes required at this profile level. Composes with the core DataDownload at the model-composition step.

attribute.name: characterSet
attribute.definition: cdi:characterSet - character encoding of a text-based distribution (e.g. UTF-8). Required by CDIF Data Description for text distributions.

attribute.name: fileSize
attribute.definition: cdi:fileSize - file size of this distribution as a number.

attribute.name: fileSizeUofM
attribute.definition: cdi:fileSizeUofM - unit of measure for fileSize (e.g. 'byte', 'KB', 'MB').

class._comment: PrimaryKey - target of cdif:hasPrimaryKey on the dataset.
Statistic - target of cdif:statistics on the dataset. DDI-CDI 1.1beta has CategoryStatistics (renamed from CategoryStatistic in 1.0); mapped here with class rename.

skos:Concept stub. Local target class so attributes typed as 'Concept' (e.g. InstanceVariable.physicalDataType) resolve inside this profile. The canonical SKOS Concept definition lives in the CDIFCodelist profile; cross-profile HTML links point readers there. DDI-CDI's PairedControlledVocabularyEntry / ControlledVocabularyEntry are implemented across CDIF profiles as references to skos:Concept.
class.definition: skos:Concept (stub). A reference to a controlled-vocabulary term defined in a SKOS ConceptScheme; full definition in CDIFCodelist::Concept.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id - resolvable URI for this concept.

attribute.name: prefLabel
attribute.definition: skos:prefLabel - preferred lexical label.

attribute.name: inScheme
attribute.definition: skos:inScheme - URI of the owning ConceptScheme.

sssom.comment: CDIF profiles flatten the DDI-CDI scheme+term DataType into a plain skos:Concept reference. The Concept definition itself lives in CDIFCodelist.

class._comment: Identifier (schema:PropertyValue) stub. Local target class so attributes typed as 'Identifier' resolve inside this profile; the canonical definition lives in the CDIFCore profile.
class.definition: schema:PropertyValue / schema:Identifier (stub). A structured identifier with a propertyID (scheme), value, and optional url. Full definition in CDIFCore::Identifier.

attribute.name: propertyId
attribute.definition: schema:propertyID - the identifier scheme (e.g. DOI, Handle, ROR).

attribute.name: value
attribute.definition: schema:value - the identifier value.

attribute.name: url
attribute.definition: schema:url - resolvable form of the identifier.

class._comment: DefinedTerm (schema:DefinedTerm) stub. Local target class so attributes typed as 'DefinedTerm' resolve inside this profile; the canonical definition lives in the CDIFCore profile.
class.definition: schema:DefinedTerm (stub). A controlled-vocabulary term with name, code, and scheme URI. Full definition in CDIFCore::DefinedTerm.

attribute.name: identifier
attribute.definition: @id / schema:identifier - URI for the term.

attribute.name: name
attribute.definition: schema:name - the term's preferred label.

attribute.name: termCode
attribute.definition: schema:termCode - code value within the term set.

attribute.name: inDefinedTermSet
attribute.definition: schema:inDefinedTermSet - URI of the controlled vocabulary.

association.definition: schema:variableMeasured - variables described at the Data Description level (with cdif:physicalDataType).
Links the schema:variableMeasured wrapper to the DDI-CDI InstanceVariable being described.
cdif:hasPrimaryKey - the primary key declared for the dataset.

association._comment: cdif:statistics - target class Statistic is the renamed DDI-CDI CategoryStatistic.
association.definition: cdif:statistics - statistical summaries reported on the dataset.
